author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking digital artists for custom Pokémon scene binders
content: I’m on the hunt for digital artists! I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. Contact: DM on Threads.

author: Cassidy Cole
title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI). Contact: DM or reply on Threads.
